rationale: First-order self-draining heater with K~0.885, ambient~0.05, tau~135s needs feedforward for steady duty plus overdamped PI for residual. Kp=2.2, Ki=0.014 gives characteristic 135s^2+(1+K*Kp)s+K*Ki with discriminant >0, two real poles (~78s and ~130s), no oscillation and no overshoot in linear regime. Feedforward uff=(target-0.05)/0.885 gives ~0.51 at 0.5. Integral +-0.35 can correct K/ambient error up to ~0.31 in y, far larger than observed 0.01 residual, but prevents windup to rails. Conditional freeze when saturated stops windup during cold warm-up at u=1. 8s low-pass on y suppresses 0.005 quantization without adding lag vs 135s plant. Safety cap above 0.80 keeps hard 0.90 unreachable.

extra.machine_card: Electric heater, positive gain: more power = hotter. Gain K~0.88-0.89: yss(0.5)~0.491, yss(0.6)~0.58, ambient y0~0.05. So target 0.5 needs u~0.51. Slow: tau ~123s heating (E1), ~161s cooling (E3), ~135s average; needs ~300s to settle. No dead zone or pure delay: response starts in 9-12s for both heat and cool. Self-draining: u=0 falls 0.497 to 0.19 in 180s still falling -0.0015/s. Noise small: ~0.005 quantization steps, <0.02 total vs 0.05 band. Rate limit ~0.006 per unit u per s. Stay below 0.85 soft, 0.90 forces u=0.
extra.predicted_behavior: From cold 0.05: u=1 for ~40s until y~0.28, then ramps down, reaches 0.475-0.525 in ~150-220s and settles without overshoot. From near target: overdamped approach with <0.015 overshoot, stays in band. Steady duty ~0.50-0.53 for target 0.5 depending on true K/ambient, integral trims residual in ~100-150s. Actuation smooth, steady u^2~0.26. No chatter, no 0.85/0.90 approach in normal operation.
